# VakayGo — Caribbean Travel & Direct Booking Platform

> VakayGo is an island travel platform connecting travelers directly with verified stays, tours, boat charters, dining, and local experiences across Grenada and the Caribbean.

## Platform Overview
- **Website:** https://vakaygo.com
- **Headquarters & Primary Hub:** Grenada (Spice Isle of the Caribbean)
- **Primary Regions:** Grenada, Carriacou, Petite Martinique, and expanding Caribbean destinations (Barbados, St. Lucia, Antigua).
- **Core Mission:** Commission-friendly direct connections between travelers and verified local Caribbean hosts, operators, and guides.

## Travel Categories & Experiences

### 1. Accommodations & Stays
- **Villas & Residences:** Private luxury hillside villas with infinity pools and panoramic Caribbean Sea views.
- **Beachfront Cottages & Apartments:** Walk-to-beach accommodations along Grand Anse Beach, Morne Rouge (BBC Beach), and Lance Aux Epines.
- **Eco-Lodges & Boutique Stays:** Mountain retreats in rainforest settings near Grand Etang National Park.

### 2. Tours & Island Excursions
- **Waterfalls & Rainforest Treks:** Guided excursions to Annandale Falls, Concord Falls, Seven Sisters Waterfalls, and Mount Qua Qua.
- **Marine & Boat Charters:** Snorkeling at the world-renowned Molinere Underwater Sculpture Park, sunset catamaran sails, private yacht charters, and sport fishing.
- **Spice & Heritage Tours:** Interactive tours of historic nutmeg processing stations (Gouyave), River Antoine Rum Distillery (oldest water-powered distillery in the Caribbean), and organic cocoa plantations.

### 3. Food, Dining & Nightlife
- Traditional Grenadian "Oil Down" feasts, beachside fish fries at Gouyave, authentic roadside barbecues, and waterfront dining in St. George's and Prickly Bay.

### 4. Island Transportation
- Jeep rentals, 4x4 SUV hires for rugged island terrain, and airport pickup/transfer services from Maurice Bishop International Airport (GND).

## For Hosts & Tour Operators
- Verified local operators can list properties, excursions, and services directly on VakayGo.
- Transparent direct customer communication and automated inquiry management.
